title: Panelled Mesh Casual Shoes with Lace Closure and Segmented Sole Edge for Wholesale Shoe Assortments
highlights:
Mesh and overlay upper: Large mesh windows sit between synthetic leather panels around the front and quarter of this lace-up casual shoe.

Adjustable instep fit: The front laces let the wearer loosen the opening for entry and set the tension over the foot.

Open upper construction: The open mesh or cutout sections leave ventilation spaces around the covered areas of the foot.
